description: The VR network-traffic measurement team publishes approximately seven hours of Tshark traces from Meta Quest 2 use in a residential household. Sessions represent several virtual-reality activities, with the article describing captures of at least thirty minutes per selected session. Figshare identifies the archive and its CC BY 4.0 licence through a public versioned record and API. The data are free to obtain and can calibrate traffic-generation or network-capacity simulations for immersive applications. This is a site-specific household experiment, not a representative operator traffic sample, and the observed applications and headset are a limitation on transfer. Packet encoding and session completeness were not independently checked. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: Dataset of VR traffic measurements
notes: G4-0483; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
